title: Optihide
description: Hide/show all players on keybind (Default: H)
body:
## OptiHide

**OptiHide** is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft `1.20.x` that lets you instantly hide all players with a single key (`H`).

### Features

*   Toggle player visibility on/off in real time
*   Simple default keybind: `H`
*   Client-side only
*   Minimal and performance-friendly behavior
